title_sq: Shitet Penthouse me pamje fantastike nga Liqeni i Thate me 2 poste parkimi
description_sq: Shitet Penthouse ne nje prej projekteve me vendndodhjen me te mire perballe liqenit te thate ne Tirane. Objekti ndodhet vetem disa metra larg liqenit te thate, dhe ndertohet me nje cilesi te larte te materialeve dhe teknikave te ndertimit. Ky penthouse ka nje organizim kuadratik dhe permban 3 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete me ajrim dhe ndricim natyral, salloni i pritjes dhe veranda panoramike. Aktualisht penthousi shtrihet ne te gjithe siperfaqen e katit, pa apartamente te tjera ne ate kat, duke mundesuar intimitet dhe nje jetese shume te qete per klientin potencial. Objekti eshte ne faze te avancuar te ndertimit dhe posedon dhe 2 poste parkimii me kosto extra.
title_en: Penthouse for sale with a fantastic view of Lake Thate with 2 parking spaces
description_en: Penthouse for sale in one of the projects with the best location in front of the dry lake in Tirana. The facility is located just a few meters away from the dry lake, and is built with high quality materials and construction techniques. This penthouse has a square layout and contains 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms with ventilation and natural lighting, a lounge and a panoramic veranda. Currently, the penthouse extends over the entire surface of the floor, without other apartments on that floor, enabling privacy and a very quiet life for the potential client. The building is in an advanced stage of construction and has 2 parking spaces at an extra cost.
